title: The Lighthouse
novel:
The [[conflict|conflict]] between Robin and Loretta [[escalated|escalate]] during the weekend. They argued about recipes, family traditions, and even the wedding decorations. Barney was [[stuck|stuck]] in the middle and did not know how to make peace between them.

Loretta [[challenged|challenge]] Robin to a cooking competition. Robin, who was terrible at cooking, was [[nervous|nervous]] but accepted the challenge. She secretly [[practiced|practice]] making a simple dish in the hotel kitchen.

Barney tried to [[mediate|mediate]] between the two women. He told each of them privately that they were the most important woman in his life. This [[strategy|strategy]] only made things worse when they both found out what he had said.

Meanwhile, Marshall and Daphne [[discovered|discover]] a [[stowaway|stowaway]] on their journey. A young man had hidden in their car at a gas station. They were [[shocked|shock]] but felt sorry for him. They agreed to give him a ride to the next town.

Ted visited a [[lighthouse|lighthouse]] near the hotel. The view from the top was [[breathtaking|breathtaking]]. He stood there looking at the ocean, thinking about his future. A woman appeared at the lighthouse, carrying a yellow umbrella. Ted did not know it yet, but this was the woman he would eventually marry.

Back at the hotel, the cooking competition ended in a [[tie|tie]]. Both Robin and Loretta made decent dishes, and the judges could not choose a winner. They [[agreed|agree]] to a truce, at least for the moment.

Barney was [[relieved|relieve]] that the fighting was over. The group enjoyed a peaceful evening by the beach, watching the sun set over the water.

conflict.en: They had a conflict over money.

challenge.en: She challenged him to a race.

nervous.en: He felt nervous before the speech.

practice.en: She practiced the piano every day.

stowaway.en: The stowaway was found on the ship.

lighthouse.en: The lighthouse stood on the cliff.

tie.en: The game ended in a tie.

relieve.en: She was relieved to hear the news.
